rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１３Got a minute...?￥I need to talk to you.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１９You've been slacking on your￥Strength training lately.＝＠１４０＿０１５Keep that up, and you'll fall￥further and further behind the￥other candidates.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０１６At this rate, you won't have a￥prayer of qualifying!
＊Narusawa＊＠１４０＿０２０Today's meant to be a day off,￥but I'll open the Weight Room￥for you, just this once.＝＠１４０＿０２１You're doing extra training￥with me, starting now!
